listeners.routeOrSurface: Public menu, owner menu, authenticated non-QR menu contexts
listeners.startCondition: restaurantId exists and shouldUseRealtimeMenuMetaListener returns true; unauthenticated public and QR guest contexts skip realtime menu meta listener
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: A menu meta snapshot could update state.menu.statusBadgeVisible after a route change if not stopped before new menu state is active.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: Wrong restaurantId would show/publish the wrong public menu status badge.

listeners.startCondition: profile target exists and route is not a guest public business route context; guest public route uses one-time getDoc refresh instead
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: Late snapshots are guarded by visible profile checks, but listener cleanup still matters on fast profile changes.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: A stale profile snapshot would show wrong business profile fields if isSameVisibleProfile guard failed.

listeners.routeOrSurface: Authenticated app shell, owner/admin, header profile icon
listeners.startCondition: startLiveListeners runs for authenticated user sessions
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: Listener continues across V1 routes by design and can update userProfile/header state while the user is on public/feed/menu surfaces.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: If userProfile.restaurantId changes, dependent owner/menu/order context can change underneath the active UI.

listeners.routeOrSurface: Authenticated app shell, feed/profile social state
listeners.startCondition: startLiveListeners runs for authenticated user sessions
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: Following state can update globally while user is on unrelated V1 route.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: Low direct business/menu/cart risk; can affect profile/social state.

listeners.routeOrSurface: Chat state and header/chat badges; starts from authenticated live startup even though Chat is not V1
listeners.startCondition: startLiveListeners calls startChatThreadsListener for authenticated users
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: Chat thread snapshots can update badges/state on feed/profile/menu/orders routes.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: No direct restaurant scope; risk is non-V1 Firebase activity and badge/state pollution.

listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: Code has stale thread/modal guard; listener must still stop when modal or route closes.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: No direct restaurant scope; affects non-V1 chat modal state.

listeners.startCondition: ensureTabDataCore starts listener when active tab is orders; restaurant-admin role uses restaurant path, otherwise user path; guest uses lookup recovery
listeners.stopOrUnsubscribeLocation: stopOrdersListener when leaving orders tab and stopLiveListeners
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: If not stopped on tab change, old order snapshots could overwrite state.orders on unrelated routes.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: Wrong userProfile.restaurantId would subscribe to another restaurant's orders.

listeners.routeOrSurface: Authenticated app shell notifications and badges
listeners.startCondition: syncNotificationsPushRuntime or notifications load starts listener for authenticated user
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: Notification snapshots update badges/state on V1 routes even when notifications are not active.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: No restaurant scope; can still affect V1 header/profile icon/badge correctness.

listeners.collectionOrPath: postRef for active post detail, including restaurant/user/socialFeed-backed post documents
listeners.stopOrUnsubscribeLocation: setModalPostDocUnsubFn replacement and modal cleanup paths
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: Late post meta snapshots can update modal/post state after route changes if modal cleanup is missed.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: Wrong postRef can show wrong social counts/type for a business post.

listeners.collectionOrPath: menu item social document ref for active menu item detail
listeners.startCondition: Menu item detail activation; QR guest path is skipped in audited code
listeners.stopOrUnsubscribeLocation: setMenuDetailDocUnsubFn replacement and detail cleanup paths
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: Late menu item meta snapshots can update menu detail for an old restaurant/menu item.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: Wrong item ref would show wrong menu item social metadata.

listeners.stopOrUnsubscribeLocation: ordersUnsub is called before replacing listener and during cleanup paths
listeners.riskIfRouteChanges: Waiter is a separate app route; wrong retained restaurantId would continue showing another restaurant's orders.
listeners.riskIfProfileBusinessChanges: Wrong waiter restaurant context can update status on another restaurant's order.
